newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arab killed in West Bank shooting, settlers suspected.
newsitem.headline: Arab killed in West Bank shooting, settlers suspected.

text.p: A Palestinian motorist was shot and killed on Monday near a West Bank Jewish settlement, hospital officials and witnesses said.
They said the attackers fired from a car with Israeli license plates and may have been Jewish settlers. The victim was identified as Fathi Ali al-Sahouri, 40, a merchant from Sinjil village.
Witnesses said gunmen in a white sedan with Israeli plates fired on Sahouri's car as he drove on a road built primarily for the use of settlers near the Jewish enclave of Ofra.
Sahouri, a father of six, was taken to hospital in the Palestinian town of Ramallah, where he was pronounced dead.
Villagers in the area said another Palestinian was wounded in similar circumstances about half an hour before the fatal shooting.
A military spokeswoman confirmed the death and said the shooting was under investigation.
